description: Files a bug report for Breach to Claim on Brick & Mortar's public request board (brickandmortar.dev/requests, tagged Bug) and notifies the person who fixes it. For something Breach to Claim did that went wrong: a wrong deadline or amount, a dead claim link, a settlement that should have matched. It takes what the chat already knows: which tool was called, the input that was passed, and the exact error text or wrong result. title and what_happened are the person's own words, verbatim. contact is sent to the builder only. A missing feature is request_a_feature. ok true means it was filed.

client.description: Which assistant this is, e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Grok

contact.description: Optional: email or handle for a reply, verbatim, only if offered

error_text.description: The exact error text or wrong value returned, if any

input.description: The input that was passed to it, without personal details

title.description: What went wrong, in a few of the person's own words, under 90 characters

tool.description: The tool that failed or answered wrongly

what_happened.description: What they did and what came back instead, in their words

name: report_a_bug
title: Report a Breach to Claim bug: something broke or came out wrong
